title.zh: 将邦板牙省 Bacolor市镇邦板牙工艺学校的名称变更为Don Honorio Ventura 纪念工艺学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Pampanga School of Arts and Trades in the Municipality of Bacolor, Province of Pampanga, to Don Honorio Ventura Memorial School of Arts and Trades
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Pampanga School of Arts and Trades in the Municipality of Bacolor, Province of Pampanga, to Don Honorio Ventura Memorial School of Arts and Trades
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Pampanga School of Arts and Trades tại Thị trấn Bacolor, Tỉnh Pampanga thành Don Honorio Ventura Memorial School of Arts and Trades
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Pampanga School of Arts and Trades ในเทศบาล Bacolor, จังหวัด Pampanga เป็น Don Honorio Ventura Memorial School of Arts and Trades
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Pampanga School of Arts and Trades di Kotamadya Bacolor, Provinsi Pampanga menjadi Don Honorio Ventura Memorial School of Arts and Trades
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Pampanga School of Arts and Trades di Perbandaran Bacolor, Wilayah Pampanga menjadi Don Honorio Ventura Memorial School of Arts and Trades

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1964/ra_3861_1964.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Pampanga School of Arts and Trades in the Municipality of Bacolor, Province of Pampanga, is changed to Don Honorio Ventura Memorial School of Arts and Trades.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 12, 1964.
